title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
abstract: arXiv:2608.16334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. translated_title: 击键动力学的迁移学习用于跨设备用户认证
translated_abstract: 击键动力学（打字模式）可用作行为生物识别模态进行用户认证，应用包括欺诈预防。虽然该模态已被证明在单设备认证中效果良好，但其在跨设备场景中的应用更具挑战性。在一台设备（如手机）上学习的动力学可能不直接适用于具有不同形态因素（如平板）的次级设备上的认证，因为打字模式的变化可能导致分布漂移。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统，其中在一台设备上学习的击键动力学被适应到次级设备。适应后的数据与次级设备必然有限的训练数据相结合，用于稳健地训练二元分类器。此外，使用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕捉差异。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备击键动力学认证系统，通过适应源设备数据并结合有限的靶设备数据，有效应对分布漂移，提升跨设备认证的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-device keystroke dynamics authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, which adapts source device data and combines it with limited target device data to handle distribution drift and improve robustness.
